evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/s/f/c extends Overlay, injects GroundMarkersConfig/GroundMarkersPlugin, iterates the plugin ColorTileMarker collection, filters by plane, falls back to the configured marker color, and renders each marked tile with a BasicStroke built from borderWidth.

The private draw path uses MAX_DRAW_DISTANCE=32, WorldPoint distance, LocalPoint conversion, canvas-tile polygon rendering with configured fill opacity, and optional label rendering guarded by Strings.isNullOrEmpty.

RuneLite GroundMarkerOverlay at 68c819924cfd6bfb4848c71f74c121109f289d5a has the same MAX_DRAW_DISTANCE=32, injected config/plugin pairing, ColorTileMarker iteration, plane/color fallback logic, border-width stroke, fill-opacity polygon and optional label path.

proposals.note: GroundMarkerOverlay supersedes the earlier descriptive plural GroundMarkersOverlay label; exact v308 control flow and historical RuneLite source match nearly statement-for-statement. Confidence 0.999.
